WITH unarchive AS (
                     UPDATE games 
                     SET port=(SELECT MIN(num) 
                             FROM generate_series($2::integer, $3::integer) num 
                             LEFT OUTER JOIN games g ON g.port=num), 
                         archived=FALSE,
                         last_activity=NOW() 
                    WHERE id=$1 RETURNING *)
            INSERT INTO admin_logs (game_id, datetime, action) VALUES ($1, NOW(), 'Reinstated game') RETURNING *
